input: What did Snowflake say about consumption trends on its most recent earnings call?

output.answer: On Snowflake’s most recent earnings call (Q2 FY2027, September 2, 2026), management said consumption was accelerating: AI was bringing new workloads onto the platform, and customers using AI were consuming more across Snowflake’s data platform. CFO Brian Robins said accounts using CoCo were consuming more of the core platform, while CoWork consumption was scaling; management also said AI products contributed approximately half of the acceleration it was seeing. Snowflake said its forecast was based on observed consumption patterns and raised FY2027 product-revenue guidance to $6.07 billion, or 36% year-over-year growth.
caveats: Management did not disclose an exact consumption uplift percentage for CoCo accounts; it described the effect as noticeable and reported the AI contribution to acceleration only approximately.
The conclusion reflects management’s statements and guidance from the September 2, 2026 Q2 FY2027 call, the latest call available as of 2026-11-10.

passages.quote: Third, AI activation continues to lift overall platform consumption. Customers using AI on Snowflake consume more across the data platform, creating a structural multiplier for our business.
CoCo, when we look at CoCo, the accounts that are using CoCo are consuming more of the core as well. And so, there's this flywheel effect that we talk about.
They contributed approximately half of the acceleration that we are seeing.
As always, our forecast is based on observed consumption patterns... For FY 2027, we now expect product revenue of $6.07 billion, representing 36% year-over-year growth.
